answer: Sybil tax: each new identity pays a tax recorded in a public atlas. The tax ripples upward per identity from one funder: first pays 40 credits, the k-th pays 40+15(k-1), key-bound. To forge one more identity always costs more than the last. Auditors sample 5% and burn bonds sharing one funder trail. 1,000 fakes cost 7,532,500 against a 40,000 pool. A rented-tax ring gets no bulk discount. An honest agent pays 40 once and keeps its full share.
